dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hm? {NICKNAME}, look over there. It looks like someone left some notes...

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...During the observation of maritime creatures, a Blubberbeast pup was rescued from a ray-style clockwork meka that lost control..."

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Basic biological tests were conducted... Turned out it is much weaker than regular Blubberbeasts. If it is returned to its original habitat, the estimated chance of survival would be no more than 20%..."

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...A conclusion has been made. The Blubberbeast will be kept and taken care of in the observatory station. If it can grow up healthily, its estimated chance of survival will be increased to approximately 70%..."

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...After giving it some thought, I decided to name it 'Berrypuff.' Though it doesn't resemble berries in any way, it looked really happy when I gave it one, so Berrypuff it is."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Turn page.)

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...The research funds have been withdrawn by the supervisor, who said that the funds will be re-purposed for something like 'An Innovative Circuit Design Using Clockwork Meka to Simulate the Rock-Paper-Scissors Game and Its Sociological Impact'..."

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...Even such nonsense can be approved. What are those people even thinking..."

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...I should've gone to Sumeru and joined the Amurta there... These guys should just become mechanisms themselves if they care about those so much!"

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "...I have no choice but to go back first... But I can't find a way to take Berrypuff with me... It can't adapt to the environment on land. I have to leave it here..."

dialogues.speaker: Engineer's Notes
dialogues.text: "If my calculations are correct, the rest of the food should be enough to last Berrypuff and allow it to grow up healthily..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, the handwriting looks pretty new...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon can't stop wondering if the Blubberbeast in the note is doing alright... {NICKNAME}, shall we go in and check it out?

dialogues.speaker: Blubberbeast
dialogues.text: Blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be the "Berrypuff" that was mentioned in the note. Poor thing, it looks pale and haggard...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, did that engineer really believe their calculations were correct? The food has already run out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Maybe the Fontaine Research Institute blew up because it's full of people like this... Anyway, {NICKNAME}, let's give it some food!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do Blubberbeasts eat though? Hmmm... if there's some fish...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But this area should be teeming with fish...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmmm, it could be that it's too weak to catch up to the fish... So let's try feeding it the stuff we've got instead, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: (The helpless little Blubberbeast gazes at you with vigilance, though it has no more strength to run away.)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Blubberbeast sniffs at the food in your hands tentatively while glancing at you warily. It does not sense malicious intent from you, and cautiously takes a bite...\n...Though it was slightly hesitant at first, it quickly becomes ravenous, wolfing down all the food you hand to it. Seems like it has been starving for quite some time...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a while, the Blubberbeast regains its stamina and barks twice at you before clapping its belly, seemingly its way of offering thanks to a stranger...

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, it looks very happy and it's not that scared of us anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes, yes, eat to your heart's content, then you'll recover!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Although... Paimon doesn't think we can just leave it alone... {NICKNAME}, how about we come back and check on this Blubberbeast every now and then?

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub blub!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, Berrypuff seems to be able to recognize us now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! It's us again! We brought you food too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's feed Berrypuff something delicious just like last time, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: (For some reason, the Blubberbeast doesn't seem to be paying attention to you...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why aren't you eating anymore...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, but Berrypuff doesn't look that energetic? If it already ate, it should be more active, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, speaking about not being picky, it seems to be looking in that direction...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahhh! There is another Blubberbeast trapped by waterweeds!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So that's why it's been acting weirdly. It's too worried about its partner to eat! {NICKNAME}, let's cut off the waterweeds and set its friend free!

choices.text: Maybe it doesn't like this kind of food?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, that won't work! Being picky is bad! Well, Paimon wants to say that, but Berrypuff really looks pretty tired, so maybe pickiness is not the problem here...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: This time, the Blubberbeast sniffs the food you hand over inquiringly, before swallowing it in one gulp, happily clapping its stomach afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Blubberbeast circles you a few times as if in thanks and then turns around. Through the partition of crystalline transparence, it joins its kindred in something akin to a song, their voices joyous...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that should do it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #It seems like it's having a lot of fun with its own kind! {NICKNAME}, maybe we should leave them be for now.

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: (The Blubberbeast looks anxious and keeps staring at a particular direction...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahhh, so this is where it was hiding!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't be afraid. It's us! {NICKNAME}, let's feed Berrypuff, just like we did before!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Berrypuff doesn't seem to be scared now. Is it because it can sense there's no danger now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Good. Let's give it some food, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Blubberbeast sniffs the food you offer and scarfs it down without hesitation before affectionately licking your hand.\nIt then swims to one side and begins a joyous chorus with its friend through the glass...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, it is getting close with us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You gotta get better soon! Once you fully recover, you can go back to the sea and play with your own kind again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph? Strange, it still looks like it has no appetite...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Its friend that was trapped by the seagrass is over there, so it shouldn't have anything to worry about, right? ...Maybe it's sick?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There might be something troubling it on the other side...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Other side?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hm... We can't see it from over here. {NICKNAME}, how about we go over and take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I—It's not eating at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It keeps looking over at that direction...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? That direction?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Paimon can't see what's going on back there clearly...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Strange... Berrypuff's friend is usually here, but it hasn't shown up at all today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks she heard that Blubberbeasts can communicate using songs we can't hear...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh no, could it be trapped in the seagrass over there like last time? {NICKNAME}, let's go over and check it out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems to be in much better spirits than last time! It should make a full recovery soon and return to the sea with its companion!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Berrypuff seems a bit uneasy... Maybe it's hungry?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's feed it some food, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub blub...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, it's gotten so big! Maybe we should start calling it Berrypuffier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And it looks really healthy too, all thanks to our hard work feeding it!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuffier
dialogues.text: Blub blub!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, if that is the case, perhaps we should send it back to the sea? It is its home, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuffier
dialogues.text: Blub...?

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuffier
dialogues.text: (The Blubberbeast seems to understand your intention and looks a bit hesitant...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Doesn't it want to leave?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Paimon understands. This place must already feel like home.

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuffier
dialogues.text: Blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, it's okay! Though the sea is a vast place, you can come back anytime you want!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take the Blubberbeast outside...

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuffier
dialogues.text: Blub... blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? It's looking at the direction of the aquarium, no? Doesn't want to leave, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuffier
dialogues.text: Blub... blub!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, it doesn't seem to mean that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Its old friend is here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Even though you've grown up, you should still have fun with your friends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Berrypuff. Take good care of yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The grown-up Blubberbeast seems a little reluctant to leave. It comes to you and gently rubs your cheek, as if saying goodbye. Before swimming away, it seems to remember something. It bows its head, bites your sleeve lightly, then raises its head again, and barks softly in the direction of the aquarium twice...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, looks like you're really happy. If you recover soon, you'll be able to go out and play with your friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, Paimon thinks it's full already. Let's come back later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmmm... Seeing Berrypuff eat is making Paimon hungry... {NICKNAME}, let's get Paimon some food, too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heehee, it seems really happy to be with its friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, Paimon thinks it's full already. Let's come back later.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You offer some food and Berrypuff quickly swims out and unhesitatingly devours the treat.\nYou tentatively reach out a hand to pet the little Blubberbeast. It feels softer and warmer than you expected, almost as if you're running your hands across a plush toy made from velvet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe! It trusts us completely now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like the Blubberbeast will grow up very soon! Oh, Paimon can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Why don't we come back to visit it again later, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like Berrypuff is concerned about what's happening over there... Let's go and check it out, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Heehee, it looks very happy! Well then, {NICKNAME}, let's give it some food!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: (The Blubberbeast gently bites your sleeve and looks very anxious and upset. Seems as if it is trying to pull you to a certain direction...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, so it lost its appetite because it was worried about its friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But why would there be this many clockwork meka around here? And they're even attacking innocent animals... Shouldn't the Fontaine Research Institute do something about all this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, let's give it the food we prepared!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: ...Blub?

response.speaker: Berrypuff
response.text: (Berrypuff gazes at you with a confused look and pats its belly a couple of times. Seems it does not understand what you want...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Seems like Berrypuff can't grasp such a kind of movement for now, but it might be able to learn once it's grown a bit more!

response.speaker: Berrypuff
response.text: (Berrypuff takes a few sniffs of your food but does not eat it. Instead, it turns away...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We just fed it a while ago. It is probably not hungry now. Let's come back later, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Berrypuff can pull off such complicated movements now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, our effort sure paid off! Now Berrypuff should be just fine after it returns to the sea!

response.speaker: Berrypuff
response.text: (Berrypuff sniffs your food and bows its head gently to rub it against your hand, but it doesn't seem to be hungry...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We just fed it a while ago. It is probably not hungry now. Let's come back later, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like it is concerned about what's happening over there... Let's go and check it out, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Berrypuff
dialogues.text: Blub...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Its friends aren't trapped like last time, right? {NICKNAME}, let's go over and check it out!
